text:
pav: morning! first day — quick items: 1) Figma invite arrived but I can't access 'Component Tokens' file (Request access) 2) where's the living squad roadmap for Aurora? 3) how do I put discovery notes and request participant incentives? also curious how we name prototypes that link to tickets (we use a Jira indexer?)
ellie: welcome pav! I can add you to design:aurora. what's your SSO email?
pav: pav.s@redwood.ai
ellie: added. refresh and toggle Libraries. Component Tokens are gated; if you need edit perms share your GitHub handle.
pav: gh handle pavs-design
matt: roadmap is in Notion Product -> Roadmaps -> Aurora Squad: https://notion.so/redwood/aurora-roadmap. Designers usually add discovery notes under Research -> Discovery Notes -> Aurora.
design-ops-bot: To request incentives post in #research-scheduling with dates, cohort size, and proposed compensation. For lab bookings add to Research Calendar and tag @research-ops. If Figma SSO fails run `/ticket create "Figma SSO"` with your email. Edit rights for DS files require linked GitHub handle; run `/access request design-system` to start.
pav: thanks! question re prototypes and tickets — I saw files named `aurora-onboard-v1` and `proto/aurora-onboarding-V1`. Is there a pattern to make our prototypes auto-map to Jira tasks?
ellie: good Q. We tag prototype files with a `JIRA-<ticket>` node in the file name or add the ticket in the top file description. Preferred is `proto/aurora-onboard-jira1234-v1` (lowercase, kebab). The automation picks up `proto/` plus `jira` in the name. We'll add this to the handbook.
research-ops: also if you're running moderated tests, note the ticket id in the scheduling post so we can attach transcripts to the Jira.
pav: perfect — can access tokens and roadmap now. added my discovery note and will file the access request for edit. thanks all :tada:
